scope: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 termless criteria for editing.deccara (`ESC[1;1;3;5;7$r` over aaaaaZ/bbbbbY/cccccX), editing.decrara (`ESC[1;1;3;5;7$t` over the inverse-seeded rows) and editing.decsace (`ESC[1;1H ESC[2*x`, inconclusive by design in the pinned probe) replayed byte-exactly on a disposable App and graded on parent-journaled readScreen stored cells, cursor, attribute details and buffer facts. The pinned DECCARA/DECRARA fixtures run at the default extent, which the VT510 reference makes the stream, so their right-flank control is expected to fail there; those pinned verdicts are preserved and the separately identified effect contracts (ntilde.attr-rect.effect/v1) are graded from an independent oracle: stream and rectangle extents on the pinned fixtures, set-versus-replace, clear, toggle and restoration, selector tables, inclusive bounds, DECOM and margins, the unchanged cursor and SGR pen, and a restoration witness. The same pinned code over the pinned bytes with the rectangle extent selected first is recorded as a labeled experiment. The DECSACE setting is never read directly. Stored state only: no resolved-color, rendered-appearance, protection or pixel claim; no stock grades.
